saints.name: Sts. Ewald the Fair and Ewald the Dark
saints.title: Priests and Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: Two English priests, brothers distinguished only by the colour of their hair, martyred while preaching to the Old Saxons…
biography: The two Ewalds were English priests from Northumbria, both bearing the same name and told apart only as Ewald the Fair and Ewald the Dark. Trained in Ireland, they joined the missionary work among the continental Saxons that St. Willibrord had begun.

About the year 695 they crossed into the land of the Old Saxons to preach the Gospel. Fearing that the missionaries would turn their chief and people from the old gods, a group of pagans seized and killed them; the Venerable Bede records the honour later paid to their relics.
saints.knownFor: Martyrdom while evangelizing the Old Saxons.
